summary.text: Dru Fox is a Democratic state representative from Cheshire District 2 in the New Hampshire House of Representatives, where she has served since December 2022, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her as a school district administrator who lives in Keene.

paragraphs.text: Dru Fox lives in Keene, New Hampshire, and her career experience includes working as a school district administrator.
Fox assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives on December 7, 2022.
Ballotpedia lists her as a member of the House Transportation Committee for 2021-2022 and 2023-2024.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026, and is on the November 3 general election ballot for Cheshire 2.
